children: The inflation rate in Colombo, Sri Lanka’s capital, rose to 8.0% in August 2026 from 7.3% in the previous month, above market expectations of 7.7%.
This marked the highest reading since June 2023, as food inflation accelerated to an over three-year high of 8.5% from 6.3% in July.
In contrast, non-food prices edged down to 7.7% from 7.8%.
On a monthly basis, consumer prices ticked higher to 0.3% in August from 0.2% in the previous month.

title: Sri Lanka Inflation Rate Highest in Over 3 Years
